finding: The registered absolute-IK interface controls the Robotiq mount flange. The existing seven-phase recipe uses object-centre-relative approach/grasp heights without a measured flange-to-grasp transform. Its quaternion conversion does not supply that missing positional geometry.
native_observation: All six ac trials failed pickup and exceeded the 5-mm anchor-motion limit. All raw traces and all twelve trial/reset-warmup videos are retained; the recorded scripted rejections are not relabeled.
claim_boundary: This does not establish that the candidate is intrinsically unreachable, that the nominal 0.1628-m comment is a calibrated TCP, or that a learned policy failed.
next_gate: Measure actual robot body/link geometry and the disclosed 60-action empty-gripper motion. Bind the grasp-frame transform and corrected static controller prospectively before any further fixture acceptance. Do not invent the fingertip offset or change the 100 registered poses or scientific thresholds.
